Title: Formation of Denali (Mt. McKinley)
Content: :ibox:`text(100 Million Years)` Ago: Sedimentary rocks that would later form Denali's (Mt. McKinley's) north peak began as sediments deposited under an inland sea.

:ibox:`text(56 Million Years)` Ago: Magma rose into the sedimentary rocks. This would later form the granite rock making up Denali's (Mt. McKinley's) south peak. Tectonic forces continued to push up the land surface.
:ibox:Today: Tectonic forces continue to cause uplift in the region.
